summary: the case machine.etudeguest.serial on i686, through tests/run etudeguest, against an etude-guest that runs a repeated command again, one that reports a cancellation as the signal that ended the program, and one whose exec runs the program as a child

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 tools/etude/guest test-image utils && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} tools/etude/guest/etude-guest
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run etudeguest 'run: etudeguest: PASS'

faults.name: repeat
faults.summary: a command whose record exists is run again in place of being answered from its record

faults.name: stopped
faults.summary: a cancelled program's end reported as the signal that ended it, not as stopped

faults.name: exec
faults.summary: exec runs the program in a child and exits 0, so that the designated init's exit is not the program's
